# Midday alert, Thu 2026-11-05 (~12:25 PM ET)

**AI/chip selloff turns market-wide.** Near noon S&P 500 ~−3.3%, Nasdaq ~−5% (correction territory), Dow ~−2.2%; SOX ~−11%, possibly SOXX's worst day since Mar 2020. NVDA −7%, AMD −13%, AVGO −6/7%, MU and SNDK/WDC/STX −13%+, TSLA −9%, MRVL and LITE sliding on the deal. Selling spread to CAT −4%, JPM −3%. Staples and energy are up; WTI ~$90 ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-november-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-oil-rises-chip-stocks-141439950.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/stock-market-today-live-updates.html); [Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-nasdaq-11052026-12237014); [LITE/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-lumentum-stock-tumbling-today-93CH-5005054)).

**Desk read:** Don't add new longs in tech or AI hardware today, and don't buy the dip in semis. The regime filter should tighten. Staples and defensive holds are fine, with no re-adds. Avoids added: TSLA, SNDK, WDC, STX. MRVL avoid extended. CDNS idea pulled.
